request: Read physical AI Core resource and lease status after successful independent Astera actual inference, plus existing Router 18080 and Astera container status; no inference, Docker mutation, no DebugAI source work.

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
state=$(docker exec ai-core-model-gate python3 -c 'import os,json,urllib.request;h={"Authorization":"Bearer "+os.environ["AI_CORE_API_KEY"]};g=lambda p:json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:18184"+p,headers=h),timeout=10));s=g("/internal/handoff/status");r=g("/internal/resources/status");print("RESIDENT="+str(len(s["resident"]))+" ACTIVE="+str(sum(s["active"].values()))+" QUEUE="+str(r["queued"])+" RECOVERY="+str(len(s["recovery_pending"]))+" HANDOFF="+str(bool(s["handoff"]))+" CPU="+r["cpu_max"]+" RAM_MAX="+r["memory"]["memory.max"])')
old=$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Status}}' ai-llama-router 2>/dev/null || echo UNKNOWN)
product=$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Status}}' astera-v8 2>/dev/null || echo UNKNOWN)
msg="AI_CORE_POST_ASTERA_INFERENCE $state ROUTER_18080_CONTAINER=$old ASTERA_CONTAINER=$product"
gh api -X POST repos/seigo-gace/ai-core/issues/1/comments -f body="$msg" --jq .html_url >/dev/null
echo AI_CORE_POST_INFERENCE_READBACK=POSTED
